Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Oh, hello...
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Och, ahoj...

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Sorry, I can't right now.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Promiň, teď nemůžu.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: *yawn*
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: *zív*

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Is it time to get up already...?
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: To už je čas vstávat...?

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: ... But I don't wanna... zzzzZZZZzzz...
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: ... Ale mně se nechce... chrrr-pííí-chrrr...

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: I can come back some other time?
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Mám přijít jindy?

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Please. I need your help.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Prosím. Potřebuju tvou pomoc.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: WAKE UP!
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: VSTÁVEJ!

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Huh? Hmm. No, no. I've slept long enough.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Cože? Hmm. Ne, ne. Spala jsem už dost dlouho.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Oh... you're... No... you couldn't be...?
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Och... ty jsi... Ne... to snad ani není možné...?

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Are you the Legendary Adventurer?
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Ty jsi ten Legendární dobrodruh?

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Yes. I've returned. I've returned to fix everything here.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Ano. Vracím se, abych tu všechno dal/a do pořádku.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: I don't know. I can't remember. I hope so.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Nevím. Nepamatuju si to. Doufám, že ano.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: No. I'm not. I'm just {PlayerName}.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Ne, nejsem. Jsem jen {{PlayerName}}.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: You don't expect me to believe you so easily, do you?
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Snad nečekáš, že ti tak snadno uvěřím?

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: How exactly do we do that?
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Jak přesně to uděláme?

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Not through flattery like that, that's for sure!
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Takovým lichocením určitě ne, to si piš!

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Only the Legendary Adventurer can be allowed to pass. To prove yourself... you'll need to solve my riddles.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Projít smí jen Legendární dobrodruh. Aby ses prokázal/a... budeš muset vyřešit mé hádanky.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Ooh! More riddles! Fun!
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Ó! Další hádanky! To bude zábava!

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Hm. More riddles. Okay...
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Hm. Další hádanky. Tak dobrá...

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Agh! More riddles?! No!!!
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Ach ne! Další hádanky?! To snad ne!!!

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Well... whoever you are... hello!
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: No... ať už jsi kdokoli... zdravím!

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: I'm the Guardian of Resilience. Don't wear it out.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Jsem Strážkyně houževnatosti. Tak ji hned neopotřebuj.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Just beyond this grotto are the waters of <Lore>Candy Cove</Lore>...
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Hned za touto jeskyní jsou vody <Lore>Cukrové zátoky</Lore>...

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: ...an island that I'm sworn to guard.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: ...ostrova, který jsem přísahala chránit.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: We, uh... well, we met your sister already, back in Shipwreck Shores. Does that help?
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: My, eh... no, už jsme potkali tvou sestru tam v Pobřeží vraků. Pomůže to?

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Oh, yes. My sister, Discovery.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Och, ano. Moje sestra, Objevitelka.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: You may have made friends with her, but you haven't proven yourself to me yet.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Možná ses s ní spřátelil/a, ale mně jsi ještě nic nedokázal/a.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Tell us, oh Guardian of infinite wisdom and whatnot...
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Pověz nám, ó Strážkyně nekonečné moudrosti a tak vůbec...

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Love that enthusiasm. You're gonna do great.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: To nadšení se mi líbí. Povede se ti skvěle.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: These ought to prove that you have the <Lore>spirit of resilience</Lore>.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Tyhle by měly dokázat, že máš <Lore>ducha houževnatosti</Lore>.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Good luck!
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Hodně štěstí!

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Wow, don't sound so excited. Don't worry. I know you're gonna do great.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Páni, nepřeháněj to s tím nadšením. Neboj. Vím, že to zvládneš skvěle.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Don't worry. I just know you're going to have so much fun doing my riddles!
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Neboj se. Úplně vidím, jak se u mých hádanek budeš bavit!

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Dear, if you don't believe in yourself, how do you expect anybody else to believe in you?
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Drahý/á, když si nevěříš ty, jak můžeš čekat, že ti bude věřit někdo jiný?

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Never heard of you. But you look an awful lot like a certain Legendary Adventurer.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Nikdy jsem o tobě neslyšela. Ale vypadáš úplně jako jeden jistý Legendární dobrodruh.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Mmm. All right, all right. I've slept long enough.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Mmm. Tak dobrá, tak dobrá. Spala jsem už dost dlouho.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Ahhh! Okay, okay. I'm up already.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Ááá! Dobrá, dobrá. Už jsem vzhůru.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Ah, you've completed my riddles.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Á, mé hádanky máš zdárně za sebou.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Beyond this gate lies <Lore>Candy Cove</Lore>, an island made of sugar and sweets.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Za touto bránou leží <Lore>Cukrová zátoka</Lore>, ostrov stvořený z cukru a sladkostí.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Let me open the way for you. When you reach land, keep an eye out for <Lore>the Oracle</Lore>. She'll be able to help you find the next Sunken Echoes.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Dovol mi, abych ti otevřel cestu. Jakmile dorazíš na pevninu, poohlédni se po <Lore>Věštkyni</Lore>. Ta ti pomůže najít další Potopené ozvěny.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Who is this Oracle?
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Kdo je ta Věštkyně zač?

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Can I get a description? Height, hair, eye color...
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Můžeš mi ji popsat? Výška, vlasy, barva očí...

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Oh great. More mysterious people to watch out for.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: No skvělé. Další tajemné postavy, na které si musím dávat pozor.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: That, you'll have to learn for yourself.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: To už budeš muset zjistit na vlastní pěst.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: But be careful. There's also a <Lore>villainous pirate</Lore> waiting for you in the waters beyond.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Ale buď na pozoru. Ve vodách, které tě čekají, číhá i jeden <Lore>podlý pirát</Lore>.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Don't worry though. Now I know you have the resilience to face anything that awaits you.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Ale žádné strachy. Teď už vím, že máš dostatek odhodlání čelit všemu, co tě tam venku potká.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Sail on, Legendary Adventurer. You got this.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Šťastnou plavbu, legendární dobrodruhu. Ty to zvládneš.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Don't worry. She's very Oracle-y. I bet you won't have any trouble at all.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Neboj se. Je to věštkyně každým coulem. Vsadím se, že ji poznáš bez sebemenších potíží.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.en: Trust me, the Oracle is worth the search.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Resilience/Guar.cz: Věř mi, Věštkyni se vyplatí hledat.
